content_text: Reading your answer made me realize that I wasn’t following my own ethos of having a versatile light as the reason I was looking at using a light was that I wanted something to double as a key when not in sun, but that’s limited and now I found a 1.6kw hmi better in my price range that claims to be the equivalent of 6kw of tungsten light but can also outright use 2kw tungsten bulbs, now could either of these work for augmenting daylight as a key light just off camera in a wide shot?
